subject: [PATCH 30/60] mm/memory_hotplug: keep private memory out of the auto-movable ratio

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: No review comments have been made so far. The thread is waiting for a response from the community.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the auto-movable online policy by excluding private memory from the movable:kernel balance calculation. The current implementation counts all populated zones, including private memory in ZONE_NORMAL, as kernel memory, which can lead to over-allocating movable memory. This patch specifically addresses this issue by leaving zones and dynamic memory groups on private nodes out of the statistics used for the ratio computation.
